_comment: Single-key panel. Everything routes through OPENROUTER_API_KEY — no Gemini or xAI account needed. Trade-offs are real and listed below; use presets/judge-panel.json once you have a direct Gemini key.
_tradeoffs: NO NATIVE VIDEO. The OpenRouter adapter sends image parts only, so the scroll recording never reaches a model — every visual seat scores sampled keyframes. Motion evidence is weaker but honest: the judge is told so and scores motionFidelity accordingly. `web.sendVideo` is false here to make that explicit rather than silently degrading.
SINGLE TRANSPORT. All six seats ride one provider; an OpenRouter outage takes the panel to zero instead of to quorum. verify:panel warns about this by design — the warning is correct, not noise.
Model diversity is unaffected: six labs are still six labs. Only the transport and the video path are narrowed.
_upgrade: Add GEMINI_API_KEY and switch the gemini seat to provider:'gemini' (see presets/judge-panel.json). That one key restores native video judging AND puts a seat off OpenRouter so an outage cannot take the panel below quorum. XAI_API_KEY is optional — Grok runs fine over OpenRouter.
